multi_entity_note: Two companies, PivX Corporation (licensor) and Detto Technologies (reseller), each with its own address.
processing_note: All payments to PivX shall be made within thirty (30) days after the receipt by Detto of the PivX's invoice.

contract.document_name.rationale: The title and the preamble name the contract 'Reseller Agreement'; the Exhibit A addendum name is a different document.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The 'entered as of' date has blank day and month, so only the year 2004 is stated.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The Effective Date is defined as the blank-dated 'entered as of' date, so only the year is stated; the defined-term occurrences are not values.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The term runs six months from the blank Effective Date; no expiry date is stated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Section 6.7 selects the laws of the State of California; other California/Washington mentions are incorporation, addresses, or venue.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement has a fixed six-month term with no renewal provision.

contract.notice_period.rationale: There is no renewal, so no notice period to prevent renewal; the 30-day notice is for termination for convenience.
